4.A. History and Development of the Company
Corporate History and Structure
Big Tree Cloud Holdings Limited
was incorporated in the Cayman Islands on September 25, 2023 as a merger vehicle to facilitate the Business Combination between Plutonian
a blank check company incorporated in the state of Delaware which was formed for the purpose of effecting a merger, capital stock exchange,
asset acquisition, stock purchase, reorganization or similar business combination with one or more businesses, and Holdco, which was incorporated
in Cayman Islands. Upon closing of the Business Combination on June 6, 2024, Holdco merged with Merger Sub 1, with Holdco being the surviving
entity. Plutonian merged with Merger Sub 2, with Plutonian being the surviving entity. As a result of the Business Combination, both Holdco
and Plutonian became wholly owned subsidiaries of the Company and the business of Holdco became our business. Plutonian was deregistered
in April 2025. Starting from June 7, 2024, our Ordinary Shares were listed on Nasdaq Global Market under the symbols “DSY”
and the Warrants were listed on the Nasdaq Capital Market under the symbol “DSYWW.” On April 9, 2026, the listing of our Class
A Ordinary Shares was transferred from the Nasdaq Global Market to the Nasdaq Capital Market, and our Class A Ordinary Shares continue
to trade under the symbol “DSY.” Our Company conducts all of our operations and generates all of our revenue through our subsidiaries
in the PRC.

Disposals of Subsidiaries
On July 29, 2024, Guangdong
Dashuyun entered into a share transfer agreement with Shenzhen Baicheng Wandian Trading Partnership (Limited Partnership), a third party,
to dispose of all of the equity interests in its wholly-owned subsidiary, Dongguan Dashuyun Daily Necessities Co., Ltd., together with
its branches, for a total consideration of RMB38,000,000. The disposal was completed on September 3, 2024. On September 8, 2025, Guangdong
Dashuyun entered into a share transfer agreement to transfer all of its 51% equity interests in Guangdong Yunjia Innovative Materials
Co., Ltd. (“Guangdong Yunjia”) to Guangdong Jiasiwei New Materials Technology Co., Ltd. (“Guangdong Jiasiwei”).
See “—B. Business Overview—Discontinued Operations.”
Nasdaq Notification Letters
On March 13, 2025, the Company received a deficiency notice from Nasdaq
notifying the Company that, for the 30 consecutive business days from January 27, 2025 to March 12, 2025, the Company’s market value
of publicly held shares (“MVPHS”) was below the minimum of US$15 million required for continued listing on The Nasdaq Global
Market under Nasdaq Listing Rule 5450(b)(2)(C) (the “MVPHS Requirement”), and the Company was given until September 9, 2025
to regain compliance.
On July 11, 2025, the Company
received a notice from the Staff of Nasdaq notifying the Company that Staff has determined that for the last 11 consecutive trading days,
from June 25, 2025 to July 10, 2025, the Company’s MVPHS has been US$15 million or greater. Accordingly, the Company has regained
compliance with the MVPHS Requirement.
On November 18, 2025, the
Company received a written notification (the “Bid Price Notification Letter”) from Nasdaq notifying the Company that it was
not in compliance with the minimum bid price requirement set forth in Nasdaq Listing Rule 5450(a)(1), which requires listed securities
to maintain a minimum bid price of US$1.00 per share. Based on the closing bid price for the last 30 consecutive business days from October
7, 2025 to November 17, 2025, the Company no longer met the minimum bid price requirement. In accordance with Nasdaq Listing Rule 5810(c)(3)(A),
the Company was provided a compliance period of 180 calendar days, or until May 18, 2026, to regain compliance.
On December 29, 2025, the
Company received a notification letter from Nasdaq, based on Nasdaq’s review of the Company’s Market Value of Listed Securities
(“MVLS”) for at least 30 consecutive business days from November 13, 2025 to December 26, 2025, stating that the Company’s
MVLS was below the required minimum of US$50,000,000. Pursuant to Nasdaq Listing Rule 5810(c)(3)(C), the Company was granted a 180-calendar-day
compliance period, or until June 29, 2026, to regain compliance with the MVLS requirement.
On December 31, 2025, the
Company received an additional notification letter from Nasdaq, based on Nasdaq’s review of the Company’s MVPHS for at least
30 consecutive business days from November 6, 2025 to December 30, 2025, stating that the Company’s MVPHS was below the required
minimum of US$15,000,000. Pursuant to Nasdaq Listing Rule 5810(c)(3)(D), the Company was granted a 180-calendar-day compliance period,
or until June 29, 2026, to regain compliance with the MVPHS requirement.
On March 9, 2026, the Company
received a written compliance notification from the Listing Qualifications Department of Nasdaq, informing the Company that it had regained
compliance with the minimum bid price requirement of US$1.00 per share under Nasdaq Listing Rule 5450(a)(1). Nasdaq determined that the
closing bid price of the Company’s ordinary shares had been at or above US$1.00 per share for the 10 consecutive business days from
February 23, 2026 to March 6, 2026.
On April 7, 2026, the Company
received approval from Nasdaq of its application to transfer the listing of its Class A Ordinary Shares from the Nasdaq Global Market
to the Nasdaq Capital Market. The transfer became effective at the opening of business on April 9, 2026. The transfer of listing did not
affect the trading of the Company’s securities, and the Company’s Class A Ordinary Shares continue to trade under the symbol
“DSY.” Following the transfer, Nasdaq notified the Company that the MVLS and MVPHS matters were closed.
Registered Direct Offering
On September 29, 2025, the
Company entered into a definitive securities purchase agreement with an institutional investor for the purchase and sale of 8,064,516
ordinary shares, par value US$0.0001 per share (before giving effect to the Share Consolidation), at a purchase price of US$0.62 per
share (before giving effect to the Share Consolidation), in a registered direct offering. The offering closed on September 30, 2025.
The aggregate gross proceeds to the Company were approximately US$5.0 million, before deducting placement agent fees and offering expenses.
The ordinary shares were issued pursuant to a prospectus supplement dated September 30, 2025, filed with the SEC in connection with a
takedown from the Company’s shelf registration statement on Form F-3 (File No. 333-289941), which was declared effective by the
SEC on September 9, 2025. Aegis Capital Corp. acted as the exclusive placement agent for the offering and received a cash fee equal to
6.0% of the gross proceeds. Concurrently with the execution of the securities purchase agreement, the Company’s officers, directors
and shareholders holding ten percent (10%) or more of the Company’s ordinary shares entered into lock-up agreements for ninety
(90) days following the closing of the offering. We submitted the filing with the CSRC in respect of the offering on October 11, 2025.
See “Use of Proceeds” under “Item 14. Material Modifications to the Rights of Security Holders and Use of Proceeds.”
Extraordinary General Meeting, Share Consolidation
and Dual-Class Share Structure
On January 30, 2026, the
Company held an extraordinary general meeting, at which the shareholders of the Company approved, among other things, (i) the adoption
of the second amended and restated memorandum and articles of association of the Company, in its entirety and in substitution for and
to the exclusion of the then effective amended and restated memorandum and articles of association; (ii) the consolidation of every twenty
(20) issued and unissued ordinary shares of a par value of US$0.0001 each into one (1) ordinary share of a par value of US$0.002 each;
(iii) the change of the authorized share capital of the Company from US$50,000 divided into 25,000,000 ordinary shares of a par value
of US$0.002 each to US$50,000 divided into 20,000,000 Class A Ordinary Shares of a par value of US$0.002 each and 5,000,000 Class B Ordinary
Shares of a par value of US$0.002 each; and (iv) the redesignation of the 3,500,000 issued ordinary shares registered in the name of PLOUTOS
